letter.headline: Your home could qualify for free solar panels.
letter.intro: Your area is part of a government scheme that pays for energy improvements in some homes. Your roof could take 16 solar panels. We can check whether your household qualifies and, if it does, arrange the survey through your council.
letter.qr_caption: Scan to see your roof and your full quote
letter.small_print: Figures are estimates from your roof's size, pitch and direction and typical sunshine for your area; your surveyor confirms them before you decide. This letter went to the occupier of this address. If you would rather not hear from us, call 0300 000 0000 and we will take the address off our list.

offer.headline: Check whether your household qualifies
offer.body: The scheme is run by councils in England. If you qualify, the work is paid for by the grant.
criteria: A household income under £36,000, a means-tested benefit, or a qualifying postcode
An energy rating (EPC) of D to G
You own the home or rent it privately
